Subject: Onboarding & PO requirement for pilot — request for invoice-only

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. We're excited to spin up a 6-week pilot of Redwood Inference for our evaluation team. A quick procurement note: StratusWave is still a small outfit and we don't issue purchase orders for trials. Can you accept an invoice (net 30) for the initial pilot fee (~$3,250) so we can get started this week?

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and W9. Happy to sign an MSA if required.

Attachments:
- StratusWave_Onboarding_Form.pdf (vendor intake form)
- StratusWave_W9.pdf

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Ops
StratusWave
elena@stratuswave.io
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO requirement for pilot — request for invoice-only

Hi Elena — thanks for sharing the forms and for the fast follow-up.

Short answer: Redwood's standard onboarding requires a PO for any vendor setup that will be routed through AP. That said, Procurement has an invoice-only exception for pilot engagements below a threshold and with certain controls (signed agreement, capped invoice, and limited term). I'm looping in procurement and finance to confirm.

Aditya / Marissa / Lauren — can we approve a one-time invoice-only onboarding for StratusWave at <= $3,500 for a 6-week pilot? StratusWave has provided the onboarding form and W9 and says they're willing to sign our MSA. Proposed controls:
- Single invoice (no recurring automated billing)
- Term capped to 6 weeks
- Invoice to be routed to AP with reference "SW Pilot — RDW"
- Proof of insurance or SOC2 Lite preferred (if not available, limit spend to $3,500)

Elena — if this works, please confirm the exact invoice amount and attach a signed MSA when ready.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO requirement for pilot — request for invoice-only

Chloe — thanks for the context. Procurement grants a conditional exception.

Approved: one-time invoice-only onboarding for StratusWave, up to $3,500, subject to these conditions:
1) Signed MSA uploaded to DocStore and attached to AP submission.
2) Invoice must include "Pilot Exception: STRATUSWAVE - RDW" and be payable net 30 to Redwood Inference.
3) Exception expires after this invoice — any additional spend requires normal PO process.
4) Finance will create a temporary vendor code with restricted payment method.

I've attached the completed procurement_exception_form for record-keeping.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- procurement_exception_form_signed.pdf
